page.overview:
Who is Komane?

Komane is the deposed princess of the Lulusia Kingdom, being the daughter of the former king Seki.

Komane is a fit woman of average height, with black long hair with two hair rose ornaments. She wears a dark colored strapped short dress, light skirt, and dark high heel shoes. She also has a dark coat.

After she was abducted by pirates, she was shown crying for her father to be contacted so he would pay for her release, showing some sort of trust in him as much of a scared sense of self-preservation. She also appeared to be vindictive as after she was saved by Koby and Helmeppo, she attacked the pirates angrily while threatening to have them tortured, and insisted to her father to let her kill some rebels herself once the Marines rescue them from imprisonment.

As the princess, Komane had great authority over her home country. However, she lost her power after being deposed.
